entities.summary: Aya Chebbi, is a Tunisian diplomat, and a pan-African and feminist activist. She became the first appointed African Union Envoy on Youth in November 2018. Appointed by the chairperson of the African Union Commission, Moussa Faki, in November 2018, as the youngest senior official in the history of the African Union, and youngest diplomat in the chairperson's cabinet.
